title: wb approve: one verb for whatever human decision is pending
desc:
Approval today is per subsystem, e.g. wb impl verify --approve '<exact text>', retyped by hand. The user should not need to know which gate is waiting.

ACCEPTANCE:
- wb approve resolves the ticket like wb next and shows the one pending decision (plan, verify commands, scope amend, PR) with what is being approved
- wb approve with no pending decision says so and exits 0
- approving never runs anything the user was not shown in that same output
- wb status and wb next point to wb approve whenever a gate is waiting
